about.title: Rabet, Powered By
about.subtitle: Ahmed Bashammakh Group
about.text: Rabet is developed by Ahmed Bashammakh Group for Business Services (ABG), a Saudi business services group established in 1991, specializing in business consulting, company formation, and government licensing services. For more than 35 years, we have supported businesses, entrepreneurs, and investors in navigating government requirements and completing business-related procedures in Saudi Arabia. Today, we're bringing that experience into a more accessible digital platform designed to simplify how businesses access and manage government services. Our goal is to make government services easier to understand, request, and track, all through one convenient mobile application.
about.cardTitle: Decades of Experience. A Smarter Digital Experience.
about.cardText: Rabet is a privately operated application developed by Ahmed Bashammakh Group. It is not a government application and is not affiliated with any government authority. Official procedures are processed through the relevant government platforms and authorities.

updates.title: That Matter To Your Business, All In Rabet
updates.text: Government regulations, requirements, and procedures continue to evolve, and staying informed is essential for every business owner and investor in Saudi Arabia. That's why Rabet includes a dedicated news and updates section to help you discover the latest developments related to business licensing, company formation, employee services, economic activities, and more.
updates.tagline: Stay Updated on Developments That Matter to Your Business, All in One Place.

items.a: Rabet is a mobile app that brings the government services your business needs together in one place. You can explore requirements, request services such as company formation, Commercial Registration, licensing and employee services, track every request, and follow the government updates that affect your business.

No. Rabet is a privately operated application developed by Ahmed Bashammakh Group for Business Services. It is not affiliated with any government authority. Official procedures are processed through the relevant government platforms and authorities.
Yes. Rabet is free to download from the App Store and Google Play. You only pay for the services you choose to request, and the price is shown before you submit.

items.q: Can I Establish a Company in Saudi Arabia Through Rabet?
items.a: Yes. Use the Business Setup Guide to find the requirements for your investor category and business activity, then request company formation assistance through Rabet. Our team supports you throughout the establishment process.

items.q: Is Rabet Suitable for Foreign Investors?
items.a: Yes. Rabet covers company formation for Saudi citizens, GCC nationals and foreign investors, including investment licensing and the requirements involved in operating a business in Saudi Arabia.

items.q: How Can I Track My Service Request?
items.a: Open My Requests in the app. You can see the current status of each request, follow every stage of its execution, and see whether any additional information or documents are needed.

items.q: Can I Contact Someone About My Request?
items.a: Yes. You can communicate with our team directly within your service request, and our team will help you with the required information, documents and procedures.

items.q: Are All Government Services Available in Rabet?
items.a: Rabet offers a wide and growing range of government and business services, but not every government procedure is available. Browse the services list in the app to see what you can request today.
Requirements, government fees and processing times vary depending on the service and the relevant authority. Each service in the app shows its details and requirements before you submit your request.
